mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM buildings WHERE community_id = c.id) AS building_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM units u JOIN buildings b ON u.building_id = b.id WHERE b.community_id = c.id) AS unit_count FROM communities c ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO communities (name, address, area, contact_phone, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{area}, #{contactPhone}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE communities SET name=#{name}, address=#{address}, area=#{area}, contact_phone=#{contactPhone}, description=#{description} WHERE id=#{id}
